title: 星穹铁道时间线
body:
# 星穹铁道时间线
来源：https://honkai-star-rail.fandom.com/wiki/Timeline

A very rough estimation of the timeline of events in the ''Sea of Quanta, which leads to a millennia-long battle between the two entities; the Tree attempts to absorb the Sea, while the Sea attempts to drown the Tree. In consuming the Sea of Quanta, the Imaginary Tree grows an innumerable quantity of branches and leaves, which become worlds and civilizations respectively. These branches create the numerous worlds in which ''Honkai: Star Rail'' takes place.'''', Part 1, Chapter XVII: ''Thunders Over Nagazora''

* Through the creation of all life due to the emergence of the Imaginary Tree, a force known as Imaginary Energy comes into existence.

* Stars start shining and releasing heat.

* Humanity and language come into existence.

* HooH Dev Log1

* Long unravels the revelation of the Permanence, and Long's Scions emerge.This placement is based on the fact that in ''Honkai Impact 3rd, Part 2, Chapter 9: If Destiny Concludes Today'', Nahralab, a Scion of Permanence, died at least a billion years ago, meaning that Long's Scions existed at least a billion years ago.

## Before the First Prosperity

## Dusk Wars

* The Qlipoth Dev Log2

* '''180 AE''' — End of the "blank" period supposed by the Interastral Peace Corporation.

## Unknown Time Period

* Imaginary Tree Theory after compiling data from the tomes he recorded on the Imaginary Tree.
** He claims in his theory that the universe is filled with the Imaginary Energy that isolates star clusters from each other and even light cannot pass through it. Therefore, humans would be able to travel through the universe if they manipulate Imaginary Energy.

* Zandar builds IPC Broadcast #1

* '''~1357 AE''' — Long Night Walker

## Post-Swarm Disaster

* '''~1557 AE''' — Genius Society Seat 56, Luocha and recreate the Synesthesia Beacon.Interactable: Herta's Office, Elias Salas' Portrait

* Herald of the Sea of Stars
** When her machinery was completely worn out and no longer replaceable, Sam-3000 passed on her position, with the expectation of great success for the Nameless.

* Finality's prediction: A silk accessory suitable for women will bring about the end.
** Enigmata's riddle: THEY leave no question, but the answers are "blood" and "flower."
** The Fall of Logic
** Afterwards, planets of Laurel Wreath were reduced to the domain of inorganic life.
** Aha's followers rioted against the Machine Empire by developing a troll virus called "Philosopher's Poison" and infected Rubert's computer systems.

* '''November 21, 3287 SC''' — Heavily damaged by the Xianzhou Civil War, the Xianzhou Yuanqiao plunges into a red giant, killing over 130 billion people.
* '''December, 3287 SC''' — The Aurumatons of the Xianzhou led revolt under the influence of the Anti-Organic Equation.
** '''February, 3288 SC''' — Both sides of the Xianzhou Civil War agree to a ceasefire to join forces to defeat the Aurumatons.
** '''May, 3290 SC''' — Zhige, the master primus of the aurumaton, led a force of brave fighters aboard Dialogue Log

* During his Self-Coronation to create a The Prime Mover of Life

* The Interstellar Energy War ends during this period.

## Unknown Time Period

* After the Second Emperor's War, Nanook Dev Log2

* Messenger of the Cosmos
** While the Astral Express was journeying close to the border frontier planet of Frati, the former Navigator and passengers all vanished mysteriously due to an anomaly. At the request of the conductor, Oakley temporarily assumes the position of Navigator.
** After approximately six months and two days of serving as Navigator and gathering a sufficient number of new passengers, Oakley leaves the Express, making her the shortest serving Nameless Navigator.

* Starry Cape Dancer
** In her active period, many passengers boarded the Astral Express just to listen to Dolly's voice, even including Akivili THEMSELF, who returned to the Express to personally speak to her.

## Post-Second Prosperity

* Sentinel of Time

* Around this time, Akivili suddenly disappears.

* When The Nameless sensed the fall of Akivili, Dolly's mysterious condition that began to crystallize her also started to show. After singing continuously for three days, she hands over her position as Navigator to Isee.
** Many factions within the Path of Trailblaze begin to turn against each other to take the position of the next Navigator. To resolve this, Isee invited the Nameless to play a game. He assigned random missions to the Nameless, and slowly, they all began to die off.

* Witnessing the destruction of THEIR homeworld Adlivun, Five Lineages of the Vidyadhara made an alliance on the Yuque, putting their sacred vow into writing. "This oath shall remain unbroken, standing stronger than even earth and steel."

* '''5320 SC''' — The Yuque Divination Commission witnesses the total destruction of Muldrasil by the Lan Dev Log2

* '''2144 AE''' — Legend claims that when Experiment Progress: Inorganic, Experiment Archive: Archive 03

* The connection between worlds was barely maintained and the Crew of the Express was reduced to just two members.

* In one of their stops, Isee saw something that made him lose all hope for the destination that lies ahead. He retired shortly after.
** After resigning from the position of Navigator, Isee departed from the Astral Express Crew. He purportedly turned to the Path of Enlightenment Beacon

* Under Falcon's leadership, the Astral Express regained its former glory, with up to one hundred of passengers at one point.
** He continues to seek out other Nameless who departed after the fall of the Trailblaze, reclaiming the obstructed silver rail alongside many heroic figures. Many people in the worlds he passed through were inspired by Falcon and volunteered to join the cause of Trailblazing as a new generation of the Nameless.

* Light-Chasing Guileless
** In the worlds rescued by Granholm, many were inspired by him and became new Nameless. There were also many old friends who chose to stay on these worlds in the hope of bringing a better tomorrow to these lands.

## War of Independence

* '''2147 AE''' — The IPC loses control over the frontier prison Penacony when a Stellaron corrosion incident occurs. The prisoner Hanunue ignites the War of Independence, known as the War of the Frontier to the IPC. Hanunue and the prisoners fight alongside the Masked Fools, The Nameless, File Repository: Ally — Rangers

* Tiernan attempts to return to Penacony several times but is denied entry by the Family. He resigns himself to watching over the File Repository: Ally — Intelligentsia Guild

## Dreamchaser Era

''Penacony entered an age of rapid development historically known as the Dreamchaser Era.''
* At the end of the war, with limited resources, threats from the outside world, and internal conflicts between major prison districts, the future of Asdana was uncertain. Penacony decided to take its first step towards expanding the Dreamscape.
** The Watchmaker Mikhail approached The Family with the idea of turning the prison into the Planet of Festivities, and Penacony finally gained its glory.
** The Nightingale Family extends invitations to various architects and Origami Dreamweavers Micah
** Mikhail, who returned, exposed their sinister motives, and a handful of people who decided to follow him.
** After that, Dormancy to ferry people out of the Family's dream or vice versa if necessary.
** The Family brands Mikhail and his followers as traitors to the Family in secret, while continuing to use the Watchmaker's name to publicly advertise Penacony.

* '''~1200 BF''' — A festival known as "Jarilo" is celebrated in late spring or early summer in the northern region of Nycatha.

* '''6300 SC''' — The Xianzhou Cangcheng is devoured by the activated planet Rahu.

* After dedicating his life to the Astral Express, and at the end of his journey, Granholm passes away peacefully in his favorite armchair. Shortly after that, the tale of the Astral Express quietly slipped into obscurity.

* '''~1000 BF''' — Intergalactic civilizations like History and Culture Museum

* '''2153 AE''' — Larose

* Master Diviner Kobo. However, the birth of Cherluwoo had shattered this plan. 
** After having prepared all his life to inherit the pack, Kobo led the 3,000-strong beast ship fleet that had sworn loyalty to him to reclaim his power and attacked the chief's great beast ship.
** Hosing Khan had no time to react before he was murdered by his bodyguards that Kobo had bribed. Naturally, Kobo's next targets would be Yewliho and her son.
** Fortunately, Yewliho had always retained her own fleet that vowed loyalty to her, the Preta. Although they only boasted 300 ships, every member was a trusted ally that had accompanied her on pillages for many years.
** Yewliho and her fleet successfully forced their way out of Kobo's encirclement. However, there was no way for her mere 300 ships to escape from the huge beast ship fleet that pursued them.
** However, "Kobo Khan" called off his manhunt a short while later and returned to the Bloodwind Pack, successfully becoming the next chief. Cherluwoo died during the escape.

* '''8038 SC''' — Yewliho led the Preta, with 127 men remaining, to the Fanghu, determined to submit and pledge allegiance to the Alliance after the death of her son at the hands of Kobo.

* '''8040 SC''' — After two long years of careful deliberation, the Alliance decided to pardon these borisin for their crimes and allow them to live inside the Fanghu under strict surveillance. This was on the condition that they comply with all Alliance research on borisin, as well as submitting all beast ship-related technology to them.
** This was also the time that IPC Broadcast #2

* Herta Urban Legends issue 2157 AE Month 7 is published.

* '''Halfway through 2157 AE''' — The Slaturg Nebula fell.

* Dan Shu becomes one of the leaders of the Himeko

* A group of Armed Archaeologists once
